title: Heat in the dark
briefing: The sun set eleven days ago and won't rise for three weeks. The stars are sharp, and the cold is patient. Somewhere to the southwest, the fell is warm from within.
goal: Measure the heat in the fell and place a relay the lander can see.

main_sample.label: The Warm Fell
main_sample.text: The rock is warm to the touch. The heat comes from deep below and doesn't care about night or day. It can carry us through the dark.

risk_sample.label: The Ore Outcrop
risk_sample.text: The lamp catches a streak of metal in the rock. Clean, dense ore — the best we've seen.

routes.label: Along the foot of the fell
routes.description: Longer, but the lamp reaches the rock wall the whole way.

routes.label: Through the shadow valley
routes.description: The short route. It's so dark and cold here that the suit drains twice as fast.

evacuation: The suit shuts down everything that isn't keeping you alive. ARK: “I've lit the lander's floodlights. Walk toward the light, Captain. Just the light.”

findings.main: Umbra: The fell's heat is stable. With two generators we'll get through the night.
findings.risk: Umbra: The ore is rich and clean.
findings.relay: Umbra: The relay blinks in the dark. The lander can see it.
